caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure shown in profile view, facing left. The man's skin is light beige with shading, and he has a dark beard and short, dark hair. Draped over his head and back is a lion's skin, identifiable by the paws and tail, colored in shades of yellow with dark lines indicating fur texture. Parts of the lion’s skin wrap around his body and are secured at his side. Beneath the lion’s skin, a red cloth is draped around the waist and swings behind his back. His right arm is bent and extended forward while his left arm rests on his torso, holding the lion's pelt. His legs are bare, and he stands on a stylized, dark, wave-like base, which includes green and black hues with curving lines. The background is a plain, uncolored surface.
title: Figurehead: Hercules
